title: The Labs website adopts the SGPS Agent Memory Graph (AMG 1.0, Graphiti)
body: Agent memory for blueskyz-web is the append-only log docs/memory/episodes.jsonl, checked by tests/architecture/agent-memory.test.mjs. The tool is a repository script, never a site dependency; nothing in src or the built site reads the graph.
author: owner

title: Canonical origin is https://blueskyzlabs.com
body: The organisation's canonical origin is https://blueskyzlabs.com with product subdomains. tonydemo.com is retired transition history and must not pass the production public-truth gate.
author: agent

title: GitHub Actions is source assurance only; Workers Builds deploys
body: GitHub Actions runs source assurance with a read-only token, no persisted checkout credentials, no Cloudflare secrets and no deploy commands. Cloudflare Workers Builds is the preview and production build and deployment authority. The main-promotion-governance ruleset requires a PR with strict Quality Gates and Browser Assurance.
author: agent

title: Every public sentence meets the public content standard
body: Articles and customer-facing copy are reader first, plain and natural in Vietnamese and English with the same meaning, truthful with no self-praise or unsupported superlatives, and WCAG 2.2 AA. Copy is reviewed independently before publication and re-read on the live site after it.
author: owner

title: Static-first, product-led site; Concierge and WebGL are gated
body: The site is static-first and product-led, cinematic only at the moments that matter. Presentation never creates product, claim or release truth. A remote AI Concierge needs its own architecture, privacy and security decision and Owner approval; Spatial or WebGL is an optional experiment where NO-GO is a valid result.
author: agent

title: Indexing requested for blueskyzlabs.com
body: After an old 403 was fixed and a live test passed, indexing was requested and the sitemap submitted in Search Console. Coverage is due for a re-check around 23 Nov 2026.
author: agent
